unreal_project_file.label: Selected Unreal project
unreal_project_file.description: Choose a project from the Unreal Engine workspace. The connected editor must match this project.

unreal_mcp_url.label: Unreal local connection
unreal_mcp_url.description: Resolved from the selected editor. This never launches an engine or permits a different project.

background_enabled.label: Keep Franklin available when the window closes
background_enabled.description: Closing hides IntelliFlow in the system tray and lets current work continue. Use Quit IntelliFlow in the tray to stop it. This does not start Windows automatically or keep work running while the computer sleeps.

bottom_panel.label: Bottom panel
bottom_panel.description: Show the Terminal control in the app header.

suggested_prompts.label: Suggested prompts
suggested_prompts.description: Show the prompt shortcuts when starting a conversation.

context_usage.label: Show context usage
context_usage.description: Show the text size of this conversation against the desktop context limit.

standalone_chats.label: Default to standalone chat
standalone_chats.description: Start new chats outside the selected project. Project-specific New Chat buttons keep their project.

profile_description.label: About you
profile_description.description: Local profile information. Use Personalization for instructions sent to models.

desktop_notifications.label: Desktop notifications
desktop_notifications.description: Allow YUR to show notifications from this computer.

voice_id.label: Preferred local voice
voice_id.description: Choose an available voice below; an empty value uses the system voice.

dictation_enabled.label: Enable dictation
dictation_enabled.description: The microphone still requires permission each time recording starts.

libraries_enabled.label: Enable instruction libraries
libraries_enabled.description: Allow selection from the installed Hermes, Copilot and Workforce libraries.

browser_context_enabled.label: Allow selected browser pages as context
browser_context_enabled.description: Every page still requires explicit selection. This does not allow access to other applications.

code_enabled.label: Allow Code mode and Studio code execution
code_enabled.description: Execution remains subject to the existing runtime and approval requirements.

before_send.label: Before-send instructions
before_send.description: Append these instructions to each new model request. This hook never runs a shell command.

git_untracked.label: Show untracked files
git_untracked.description: Include untracked file names when inspecting a selected repository.

pet_enabled.label: Show desktop companion
pet_enabled.description: Show a small local companion beside the composer.

trusted_contact_details.label: Contact details
trusted_contact_details.description: Stored locally for your reference. YUR never contacts this person automatically.

restricted_session.label: Restricted session
restricted_session.description: Disable model requests, Code, terminal commands and browser navigation in this YUR session. An operating-system account is still needed to prevent another user changing these settings.
